title.narrative: Australia World Bank Partnership for South Asia

description.narrative: "to contribute to poverty reduction, and sustainable development that benefits both the men and women of the countries of South Asia - namely India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Nepal, Bhutan and Afghanistan. It also aims to build more innovative and effective approaches to development for Australia and the World Bank Group in their shared work in South Asia"
